reports: hex, 64 bytes each, without the leading report ID 0x00 Windows adds

vectors.name: hello
vectors.situation: HELLO: the magic, the version, the reply queue limit and the capabilities.

vectors.name: claim_echo
vectors.situation: CLAIM's reply echoes the action and token and shows the holder; page 1 follows.

vectors.name: other_token_under_shared_claim
vectors.situation: Under A's shared claim, B's CLAIM and give up are answered OK and change nothing.

steps.label: B asks for the claim: OK, A shown
B gives up: OK, nothing changes

vectors.name: change_of_holder_resets
vectors.situation: A configures and shows a frame; B takes over: the generation steps, the takeover ends, settings return.

steps.label: A configures overlay, 500 ms, brightness not applied
page 1: B holds, no frame, settings back to the defaults
A's COMMIT under its old generation: status 4, B shown
A's HELLO under its old generation: status 4, reads included

vectors.name: exclusive_claim
vectors.situation: Under A's exclusive claim: what a request without HOLDER and the generation can and cannot do.

steps.label: B asks for the claim: never refused, A shown
A with HOLDER and its generation: OK

vectors.name: keepalive_by_holder
vectors.situation: The holder's renewals with KEEPALIVE keep its frame shown past the timeout.

steps.label: page 1 after 0.6 s: frame still shown

vectors.name: other_claims_flags_shared
vectors.situation: B's CLAIM with KEEPALIVE refreshes nothing, and with COMMIT_AFTER publishes nothing.

steps.label: B's CLAIM with COMMIT_AFTER: OK, A shown
page 1 after 0.6 s: the frame ended at its timeout, A still holds

vectors.name: other_claims_flags_exclusive
vectors.situation: Under an exclusive claim: B's CLAIM with KEEPALIVE refreshes nothing, and with COMMIT_AFTER publishes nothing.

steps.label: B's CLAIM with COMMIT_AFTER: OK, A shown
page 1 after 0.6 s: the frame ended at its timeout, A still holds

vectors.name: lost_claim_reply
vectors.situation: A CLAIM with its reply lost took the claim: the same CLAIM again shows it held, the generation unchanged.

steps.label: A claims, the reply lost (sent with NO_REPLY)
A claims again: OK, A shown, the same generation

vectors.name: takeover_between_claim_and_configure
vectors.situation: B takes over between A's CLAIM and CONFIGURE: A's CONFIGURE is refused and shows B.

steps.label: A's CONFIGURE under its generation: status 4, B shown

vectors.name: lapse_taken_again_by_a_renewal
vectors.situation: A's claim lapses; its renewal sent with NO_REPLY takes it again; its next request is refused and shows it.

steps.label: page 1 after 0.4 s: the lease lapsed, unclaimed, the generation stepped
A renews with NO_REPLY: takes the claim again
A commits under its old generation: status 4, A shown under the new generation

vectors.name: led_limit
vectors.situation: Staging at the addressable LED limit: a run up to it is staged, a run past it is refused whole.

steps.label: page 8, the Summary group: the LED limit at +2..3
STAGE a run of 1 on the last LED below the limit: staged
STAGE a run of 2 from the last LED: status 2 at [6], the count
STAGE a run from the limit: status 2 at [4], the first LED
COMMIT: the LED staged is shown

vectors.name: stale_token
vectors.situation: A page read under a token other than the current one: status 3 with the page and start, then read under it.

steps.label: page 10 under another token: status 3, the page, start and current token
page 10 under the current token: OK
page 10 from record 1 under another token: status 3
page 10 from record 1 under the current token: OK

vectors.name: state_changed
vectors.situation: After SUBSCRIBE, a claim and its give up each raise one STATE_CHANGED, carrying page 1 and the token.

steps.label: SUBSCRIBE to STATE_CHANGED: the events enabled
A claims: one STATE_CHANGED, A holding
A gives up: one STATE_CHANGED, unclaimed

vectors.name: idle_and_set_animation
vectors.situation: Model only. The idle flag, and SET_ANIMATION: the same animation, another one, and off.

steps.label: page 1: the animations idle (bit 2), after the event
SET_ANIMATION the animation shown: nothing changes, still idle
SET_ANIMATION another animation: shown at once, still idle
page 1 after the next render tick: awake, after its event

vectors.name: keyboard_mapping
vectors.situation: Page 11 in two reads, and SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING refused at [4] or [6], or for profile 0, unwritten.

steps.label: page 11 from record 16: the other sixteen
SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING from record 0xFFFF, past the last: status 2 at [4]
SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING of no records: status 2 at [6]
SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING of 255 records, past the last: status 2 at [6]
SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING with profile, first record and count wrong: status 2 at [4], the range checked before the profile
SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING for profile 0, never active: status 3, nothing written

vectors.name: keyboard_code_change
vectors.situation: Model only. The code shown writes nothing. A new code changes page 11, its counter and the token.

steps.label: SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING record 4 (B1) to its code shown, 0xE1: OK, nothing changes
SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING record 4 to 0x04: OK, then one STATE_CHANGED with a new token
SET_KEYBOARD_MAPPING record 4 back to 0xE1: OK, the token returns

vectors.name: full_reply_queue
vectors.situation: Model only. 16 replies wait unread; the 17th request needing a reply is discarded, neither run nor answered.

steps.label: HELLO 17 with 16 replies waiting: discarded (no reply of its own among them)
